Name: Valley Keepsake
Author: NatrollEXE
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56027/56027-1795624506-865623504.png[/img]

This app helps Stardew Valley players keep their mod translations and settings when mods are updated or reinstalled. Save translations in your chosen language once, then use the app to find them again instead of downloading the same translations after every update. You can also back up config.json files and restore your settings later.[/center]
[center][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56027/56027-1795631953-931664637.gif[/img][/center]
[center]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56027/56027-1795624761-542202194.png[/img]

The application scans your [b]translation library[/b] separately from the game's [b][color=#6aa84f]Mods[/color][/b] folder. A translation may remain listed after its mod is disabled or renamed. It recognizes locale files such as [b]i[color=#6aa84f]18n/es.json[/color][/b], locale folders such as [b][color=#6aa84f]i18n/fr/[/color][/b], selected [b][color=#6aa84f]assets/Dialogues/<locale>[/color][/b] folders, and supported [b][color=#6aa84f]content.<locale>.json[/color][/b] text maps.

Select [b][color=#6aa84f]en (default)[/color][/b] to save an en.json translation and, when present, keep [b][color=#6aa84f]i18n/default.json[/color][/b] or [color=#6aa84f][b]i18n/default/[/b] [/color]as an English reference. The default reference is not copied for other selected languages and is never applied over a mod's updated default file.

[b][color=#f1c232]Existing translations in the Mods folder are preserved. The application does not modify installed mods when it scans or imports translations into the library.[/color][/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56027/56027-1795624523-799140910.png[/img][/center]
[center]
[list=1]
[*]Create a folder for your translation library somewhere outside the game's Mods folder. Choose a folder for settings backups too; it may be inside the translation library or elsewhere.[/*]
[*]In Valley Keepsake, select those folders under Translation library and Settings library, then select your Stardew Valley Mods folder and the language of the translations you want to save. The app remembers both libraries for the current build. A new build asks you to select them again; the Mods folder may be detected automatically. Changing a library folder does not move existing backups.[/*]
[*]Click Find new mods. The app scans installed mods and copies translations it finds in your selected language into your library. This does not change the installed mods or download missing translations.[/*]
[*]To save your settings too, open Settings backup and click Back up all configs on Windows or Export all settings on Linux. This is a separate step from Find new mods.[/*]
[*]After updating or reinstalling a mod, click Analyze, review any uncertain matches, and use Apply selected to transfer saved translations back. Open Settings backup to restore selected configs or all missing and changed configs at once.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56027/56027-1795632984-1824423371.png[/img]

Since I have a ton of mods (almost 900), whenever I check for updates, several show up as needing to be updated, but after I update them, I lose all their translations and the config.json files (when the mod doesn't natively support my language)... So, I had this idea to restore all those files at once whenever I update my countless mods 🫠🤓

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56027/56027-1795625677-209886652.png[/img]

It is an executable application, so there's no need to install it; just download the version that matches your operating system and run it.[/center]
[center]Note: [b][color=#ff0000]You don't need to put it in your mods folder![/color][/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56027/56027-1795625797-1446220837.png[/img]

Currently, the app is only compatible with Windows, Linux, and SteamOS.

My cousin is currently working on a mobile version, since I don't know how to do that... but it might take a while, as it will depend on when he has free time.

The app interface is currently available in [b][color=#6aa84f]English[/color][/b] and [b][color=#6aa84f]Brazilian Portuguese[/color][/b]. However, we have included a folder called “Languages” so that other translation files can be added to the interface.  [color=#d5a6bd][b]♡( ◡‿◡ )[/b][/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56027/56027-1795630060-921406556.png[/img]

[b][color=#3c78d8]My cousin, Caio:[/color][/b] I definitely wouldn’t have been able to do this without him! My cousin is a senior programmer and came to my rescue whenever I asked for help! He tweaked the code, helped me fix the 999 bugs that kept popping up during testing, and showed me how to do some things I wasn’t quite sure how to handle, so I owe him a lot for helping me so much!

[b][color=#cc0000]My friend, Ana:[/color][/b] She’s such a sweetheart! She mainly helped me with the themes: I took some assets from the vanilla game itself, and we adapted them to create the borders, as well as matching the interface colors to them. (The only border we didn’t take from the game’s assets was the one for the Garden theme, since I made that one in Aseprite.)

I’m truly grateful to both of them for giving up their free time to stay with me and help me develop this app! ❤️[/center]
